reviews.title: App brilliant if you pay
reviews.text: The free part of the app is not as good as it used to be they are trying to get you to buy it and it’s quite expensive when your on a pension.

reviews.title: Bad update :(
reviews.text: The old version of this app it was amazing and great but now you have to pay to learn and they totally copied Duolingo on the set up I’m just speechless…

reviews.title: Disappointed with this app
reviews.text: I really enjoyed it and got up to unit 4 in 1 day! The only problem is that you can’t get past that unit without paying for a subscription which I don’t want to do. This has made me overwhelmingly disappointed. I do not suggest brightbsl if you are not willing to pay.

reviews.title: So incredibly awful!!
reviews.text: If i could give it 0 stars i would!! My friend downloaded this app in hopes to learn BSL.. HOWEVER they then TOOK £90 away from her!! completely outrageous she wanted to learn BSL for a little while but then just got money taken away from her? completely wrong and should be looked into as this is completely unacceptable as she now is £90 down and cannot afford daily payments, she got tricked into paying for a yearly subscription without her knowing she’s 17 with a child’s bank account and has been sent into overdraft ? completely NOT OK!! get this sorted ASAP 😡😡😡😡

reviews.title: awful app
reviews.text: I downloaded this app in order to learn BSL for my college course, only to find out £90 had been taken out of my account without my knowledge!!! I am a 17 year old student and cannot afford nearly £100 taken from me. This is completely unacceptable and i am in outrage. I can no longer afford my daily necessities such as food as my money has been confiscated by this evil app. Wouldn’t recommend to a friend. Furious!!!

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: My friend has this app and they randomly got charged £90!

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: I hate apps that force screen orientation. I choose how to hold it, not you

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: I wanted to refresh my memory, because I was born deaf but haven't had to use bsl for a while. I download the app. I do the first three topics. But then it says I must pay to continue. I thought the app was completely free? False advertising
